newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine production indices up in April.
newsitem.headline: Philippine production indices up in April.

text.p: The Philippine value of production index went up 2.7 percent in April to 438.5 from 426.8 in March, the National Statistics Office said on Tuesday.
The volume of production index increased by three percent to 147.5 from 143.2 in March.
On a year-on-year basis, the value of production index rose 10.8 percent, while the volume of production index increased 9.3 percent.
Furniture and fixture makers were the biggest year-on-year gainers as they posted a 67 percent rise in production value and 65.4 percent in production volume.
Losers were led by the transport equipment sector which posted a 12.1 percent decline in terms of value, and paper and paper products which went down 30.8 percent in terms of value.
Manufacturers of electrical machinery were the monthly biggest gainers as they posted a 19.3 percent gain in terms of production value and 19.2 percent in terms of production volume.
Biggest losers were the manufacturers of basic metals which lost 15.6 percent in terms of value and 13.7 percent in terms of volume.
The figures were based on a survey of 422 establishments located mostly in Manila. It aims to provide flash indicators on the performance of key manufacturing enterprises.
